title: Moto film QC policy (moto-film-qc-policy-v1)
description: How a cut film is checked before it may be approved. The phase-11-qc revision stores it as its prompt_content; PHP reads it from the DB; no model reads it. It names what code measures on the file and with which thresholds, which areas a reviewer looks at and which of them must be reviewed, and which findings hold an approval back. Code measures and counts; whether a stretch found is a fault and whether the film tells its story are for a person. Every value is one this version carries out.

report.description: The schema a QC report under this policy is written in.

technical.description: What code measures on the file. A stretch found is a place to look at, never a verdict: one the film plan declared (a dip to black, a silent clip) is not reported, any other becomes a finding of suspect_severity for a person to judge.

pixel_threshold.description: How dark a pixel is to count as black, from 0 to 1.

picture_ratio.description: The share of black pixels that makes a frame black, from 0 to 1.

min_duration_ms.description: The shortest stretch of a picture that does not change reported.

noise_db.description: The difference between two frames still read as no change, in dB.
The level under which sound is read as silence, in dB.

loudness.description: The loudness and the peak of the sound are measured on the file and written in the report. judge false: no target is set, so the numbers are shown and decide nothing.

suspect_severity.description: The severity of a finding code raises for a stretch the film plan did not declare.

content.description: The review of what the film says and shows. A person reviews; a model does not under this version.

areas.description: What a reviewer gives a verdict on, by id. The screen words each id.

required.description: The areas that must have a verdict of pass before the film may be approved. Each is one of areas.

severities.description: The severities a finding may have, mildest first.

blocking.description: The severities that hold an approval back while the finding is open.
